constraints.title: Scoped gate
constraints.rule: Use accept_scoped only for a bounded reviewed-record dependency map and conditional synthesis. Preserve all open coverage groups.

constraints.title: Source and model asymmetry
constraints.rule: Mark each matrix cell as inspected original, secondary attribution, project reconstruction or uninspected variant; use same C1–C6 standards.
constraints.gate_effect: No broad strongest-family ranking before P1 original-defender repair or an explicit narrower comparison.

constraints.title: Nine components
constraints.rule: Assess H-F/U/B/S/T/P/I/G/A separately with evidence IDs, bridge premises, scope and sensitivity. Task-local unresolved labels are not cumulative priors or equal support.
constraints.gate_effect: Any collapsed worldview score or automatic transfer requires revision.

constraints.title: Three judgments
constraints.rule: Keep record reliability, inference strength and component confidence separate. Reliable reporting is not event verification; accurate philosophy attribution is not premise truth.

constraints.title: Common-foundation positive case
constraints.rule: Construct the strongest proposal linking experience, existence, shared lawfulness, enduring personal significance and moral relations through stated grounding, identity, value and intention premises. Preserve possible unification gains.
constraints.gate_effect: Do not dismiss cumulative explanatory value merely because likelihoods are uncalibrated; do not count shared premises repeatedly.

constraints.title: Strongest countercase
constraints.rule: Combine actual neural dependence, unresolved timing/access, selection/cultural variation and optional PSR/modal/value/authority bridges with developed impersonal and plural alternatives.
constraints.gate_effect: Do not infer each case is explained by naming a possible mechanism, or that unknown likelihoods imply equal credibility.

constraints.title: Quantitative restraint
constraints.rule: Do not pool cases/samples or produce posterior numbers without defined denominators, disjointness, hypotheses, likelihoods and prior sensitivity. Qualitative unequal expectations need stated warrants too.
constraints.gate_effect: Missing opportunities are unknown, never automatically failures or successes.

constraints.title: Citation and search limits
constraints.rule: Retain frozen cutoff2026-09-11, English/accessible-translation scope and actual public-web methods. Distinct title queries are bounded discovery, not complete cited-by indexes.
constraints.gate_effect: No claim of exhaustive/systematic-review completion or historical reranking repair.

constraints.title: Future version control
constraints.rule: New original data or repaired claims need separate author/reviewer review; preserve accepted versions and mark affected dependent conclusions stale where changed.
constraints.gate_effect: T16–T18 drafts remain subject to joint R18 and G3; G2 is not final synthesis approval.

constraints.title: Repair triggers
constraints.rule: At T16 contract map every stronger intended conclusion to the gap that blocks it. Before T17/T18 claim that conclusion, complete its repair with review or explicitly withhold it.
constraints.gate_effect: Mandatory explicit adjudication; generic boilerplate caveats do not license a full comparison verdict.

component_requirements.label: Conscious fundamentality
component_requirements.required_boundary: Irreducibility or a necessary ground does not establish one universal subject; primitive ontology and actual dependence relation need argument.

component_requirements.label: Universal conscious whole
component_requirements.required_boundary: Subject individuation and common-world mapping remain substantive; shared motifs or one designer do not establish numerical experiential unity.

component_requirements.label: Brain independence
component_requirements.relevant_routes: NDE timing/information proposals and neural intervention constraints.
component_requirements.required_boundary: Brain influence is not the negation of every independence proposal; absent measurement is not absent processing. Need specified bearer/process and discriminating observations.

component_requirements.label: Personal survival
component_requirements.relevant_routes: Identity models and conditional anomalous/perception evidence.
component_requirements.required_boundary: Same-subject subjectivity beyond irreversible bodily death is separate from resuscitation and record preservation. Do not weaken the endpoint or identity standard.

component_requirements.label: Timelessness
component_requirements.required_boundary: Absence of external time parameter and reported altered duration do not establish absence of intrinsic succession in an actual bearer.

component_requirements.label: Preservation
component_requirements.required_boundary: Specify what persists: record, value, relation or subject. Fidelity of record is not itself H-S.

component_requirements.label: Intention
component_requirements.required_boundary: Production is not intended production; specify prior ends, level of agent and comparative expectations. Local designer does not imply purpose of containing cosmos.

component_requirements.label: Foundational goodness
component_requirements.relevant_routes: Normative premises, suffering/hiddenness and possible restoration.
component_requirements.required_boundary: Declared purposes can be indifferent or harmful; test exact goodness/love commitments. Compensation does not by itself justify permitting harm.

component_requirements.label: Moral authority
component_requirements.relevant_routes: Grounding matrix, divine nature/command, naturalist and reconstructed alternatives.
component_requirements.required_boundary: Consciousness, unity, creation, power and endurance do not automatically supply binding reasons; absent primary rival defenders prohibits broad elimination claims.

required_sensitivity_tests.remove: Strongest disputed named NDE case, chosen explicitly by criterion in T16; show a second candidate if strength ordering ambiguous.
required_sensitivity_tests.track: All nine components; do not pick weakest case simply to protect conclusion.

required_sensitivity_tests.remove: All retrospective cases/narratives, including retrospective community arm, retaining truly prospective observations at their real denominators.
required_sensitivity_tests.track: H-B/S direct empirical support versus independent conceptual H-F/I and neural constraints.

required_sensitivity_tests.remove: Contributions whose sample/event dependence is uncertain.
required_sensitivity_tests.track: Whether any supposed convergence survives without IANDS/Liège and common-case multiplicity.

required_sensitivity_tests.vary: Psychological, organism and simple-subject identity criteria; strict identity versus prudential continuity; M1–M4.
required_sensitivity_tests.track: H-S and H-P separately, plus meaning and victim-restoration consequences.

required_sensitivity_tests.remove: Central endurance-required-for-value, unity-to-obligation and consciousness-to-authority bridge premises.
required_sensitivity_tests.track: H-A/G/I versus preserved finite or enduring value claims; no moral nihilism assumed.

required_sensitivity_tests.remove: Global PSR, epistemic-to-metaphysical bridge and life-valuing designer preferences one at a time.
required_sensitivity_tests.track: Necessary-ground, H-F/U and H-I/G routes without erasing independent evidence.

required_sensitivity_tests.remove: Strongest selected neural intervention or report-to-experience proxy; test independence model with actual predictive constraints retained.
required_sensitivity_tests.track: Symmetric sensitivity of countercase without concluding that weak measurement proves extracerebral experience.

required_sensitivity_tests.restrict: Only directly inspected positive original defenders and direct replies; exclude project reconstructions from claims about authors.
required_sensitivity_tests.track: Coverage asymmetry and whether any ranking depends on unreviewed weaker rival formulations.

cumulative_status: Not assessed by G2; no numerical posterior or metaphysical verdict.
